title: FBI Photo B23
what_is_it: A monochrome still image (photo) captured by a U.S. military system, submitted by the FBI to AARO as part of a UAP report.
interpretation_warnings: The source PDF page is essentially blank — all facts derive from the CSV metadata description and narrative description, not from visible text in the document body.
The image was redacted before submission to AARO, meaning potentially identifying details (HUD data, coordinates, timestamps) may have been removed.
No mission report was provided, making this a single-source observation with no corroborating operational context.
The date stamp on the image is acknowledged as incorrect, so no reliable timestamp exists for the event.
The narrative description explicitly states it should not be interpreted as an analytical judgment or factual determination about the event's nature or significance.
The object is described only as 'dark' and 'elongated' — no size, altitude, speed, or behavior information is available.
